data.description: Any creature within 60 feet of a broken soul must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC %1) or take ld4 points of Strength, Constitution, and Charisma drain. Whatever the result of the saving throw, the creature cannot be affected by the same broken soul's baleful gaze again for 1 minute.
data.name: Baleful Gaze
